summary: Open v1.2 development and add a bounded host-neutral Evaluation Arena contract with replay identities, holdout blinding, typed quality evidence, and no automatic promotion.

candidates.rationale: Implement the planner-approved evaluation contract using existing benchmark/observability/governance primitives.

applied_changes.description: Added arena protocol/policy/tool/tests, v1.2-dev metadata, CLI/docs/impact integration, and holdout/evaluator privacy boundaries.
